items.title: Sandro Mamukelashvili holds the NBA record for the most points scored in under 20 minutes of playing time, putting up 34 points in just 19 minutes and 26 seconds on March 19, 2025.
items.author: OrganicHunt952
items.body_excerpt: He holds the record since March 19, 2025. The record was previously held by Jaylen Brown set in 2021, he scored 33 points in 19 minutes. Sandro did it against the New York Knicks, with 13-14 shooting splits and 6-7 from 3. He also had 9 rebounds 3 assists and 1 steal. Source

items.title: Good all-around games from Sandro Mamukelashvili and Goga Bitadze in Georgia's blowout win over Montenegro.
items.author: KeithSmithNBA
items.body_excerpt:
Good all-around games from Sandro Mamukelashvili and Goga Bitadze in Georgia's blowout win over Montenegro.

Mamukelashvili: 17/7/6, 2 steals
Bitadze: 23 points, 8 rebounds, 1 steal, 2 blocks

Former NBAer Tornike Shengelia led the way with 24 points for Georgia.
